description: This is a test class for the AbstractHandler class within the OpenMRS API, specifically testing behavior related to saving and retrieving complex observation data.

classes.name: AbstractHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the AbstractHandler's behavior in saving and retrieving complex observation data within the OpenMRS context.

methods.name: initializeContext
methods.description: Sets up the test context, initializes the AbstractHandler, and configures global properties before each test.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldNeverOverwritePreviousFiles
methods.description: Validates that saving observations does not overwrite existing files, testing iterative save and retrieval.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldPreserveTitleWithoutExtension
methods.description: Ensures that the filename's title is correctly preserved without the file extension when saving complex data.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldCorrectlySaveFileWithoutTitle
methods.description: Tests saving of complex data without a specific title, validating filename and key assignment.
